# Adding a feature slice

One feature = one vertical slice. `places` and `pantry` are the reference implementations;
copy their file layout and naming exactly.

## Files

```
lib/features/<feature>/
├── domain/
│   ├── entities/<thing>.dart                 # Equatable, immutable, no JSON
│   └── repositories/<feature>_repository.dart # abstract interface
├── data/
│   ├── models/<thing>_model.dart             # extends the entity, fromJson
│   ├── datasources/<feature>_remote_datasource.dart   # dio only
│   └── repositories/<feature>_repository_impl.dart    # Either-free: throws AppFailure
└── presentation/
    ├── bloc/<feature>_event.dart             # sealed, Equatable
    ├── bloc/<feature>_state.dart             # sealed: Initial/Loading/Loaded/ActionSuccess/Failure
    ├── bloc/<feature>_bloc.dart
    └── pages/<feature>_page.dart
```

## Steps

1. **Entity** — plain `Equatable` class with a `props` list. No serialisation.
2. **Model** — `class ThingModel extends Thing` with `factory ThingModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>)`.
   Tolerate missing keys (`as num? ?? 0`); the API is additive over time.
3. **Datasource** — takes `DioClient`, exposes one method per endpoint, unwraps the
   `data` envelope. Paths start `/v1/…` because the base URL already ends in `/mobile`.
4. **Repository** — interface in `domain/`, implementation in `data/`. Wrap the dio call and
   translate `DioException` into `AppFailure(message)` using the same
   `errors` → `message` → generic fallback the other repositories use.
5. **Bloc** — `on<Event>` handlers; emit `Loading` on fetch, `ActionSuccess(message)` after a
   mutation (the page listens and refetches), `Failure` on `AppFailure`.
6. **Page** — build from `AppTheme` tokens and `core/theme/warm_widgets.dart`
   (`WarmCard`, `PriorityChip`, `StatPill`, `SectionHeader`, `WarmEmptyState`, `WarmBanner`).
   Handle loading, empty and error. Touch targets 44x44 minimum.
7. **Register** in `lib/core/di/injector.dart`: datasource and repository as lazy singletons,
   bloc as a factory.
8. **Route** in `lib/core/router/app_router.dart`. A tab-level screen goes inside the
   `ShellRoute` (which renders `MainShell`); a full-screen flow goes outside it. If a new
   route belongs to an existing tab, add it to `MainShell._tabAliases` so the right tab stays
   lit (that is how `/pantry` keeps Shopping selected).

## API surface

The app talks to `/mobile/v1` and its tokens carry the `mobile` ability. Base URL:
`lib/core/config/app_config.dart`.

## Tests

| Layer | What it covers | Pattern |
|---|---|---|
| `test/unit` | pure logic (mathematics, planning) | plain `test()` |
| `test/feature` | one bloc against a mocked repository | `blocTest` + mocktail |
| `test/integration` | real widgets + real bloc + mocked data | `testWidgets` |

Traps: `BlocProvider` subscribes to the bloc, so a mocked bloc fails on a null `stream` —
use a real bloc and stub the repository. Register `registerFallbackValue('')` before
`any()` on a `String`. Assert inert controls by their handler, not by tapping them.

## Done

`flutter analyze` clean and `flutter test` green. Keep board-contract parity with the web
dashboard — if the API's board changes shape, update the `RequestBoard` entity and the Today
page in the same change.
